selectedPassagesReread.heading: A cold hand gives us a starting point
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: A concrete bodily change establishes the chapter question, then the information-flow visual distinguishes jobs and explains why input precedes processing and output.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: How can one cell reach a distant muscle?
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: A distance problem makes morphology necessary; figure reading establishes one continuous axon, receiving branches and sending terminals before structure–function inference.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: Use structure to explain function
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: Converts a labelled shape into a causal explanation: reception surface, integration, distance and distribution each earn a distinct step.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: Explain a diagram error
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: Tests representation repair: separate gaps in insulation from breaks in the continuous conducting cell, rather than reciting parts.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: Compare two different failures
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: Localizes two distinct failure sites and tests whether an unrelated proposed repair restores the missing function.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: Follow release, diffusion, binding, and clearance
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: Builds a causal sequence across two membranes, ties figure symbols to actual events, and makes new firing conditional rather than automatic.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: Worked model: include inhibition in the calculation
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: Combines signed contributions, applies a net change to a starting voltage, compares with threshold, then changes inhibition while limiting what the simplified model claims.

selectedPassagesReread.heading: Worked example: an impulse arrives but no message is released
selectedPassagesReread.uniqueTeachingFunction: Holds conduction success fixed, locates the blocked calcium-trigger step and follows only its consequences while limiting the inference to the affected terminal.
